lessons_learned: .github/copilot-instructions.md exists in this checkout and remains the first project-specific context surface after AGENTS.md.
CURRENT_STATE.md should describe the latest horizon and point to detailed ledgers instead of carrying all developmental memory inline.
Use JSONL for append-only settlement history because each record can be parsed, appended, diffed, and recovered independently.
Use state/current_state.json for low-payment agent reads of next steps, still-missing gaps, lessons, and the last settlement.
Do not treat migrated history as new capability; it is preserved substrate until queried and used in future work.
next_steps: For future milestones, update state/current_state.json, append one record to the relevant state/*.jsonl ledger, and keep CURRENT_STATE.md compact.
Keep `.claude/skills` and `.github/skills` as symlinks to the root `skills/` directory so one local skill substrate feeds both agent surfaces.
When deeper history is needed, query state/milestones.jsonl by date, artifact, status, or desired direction rather than reading the whole ledger.
Use the harness in real agent work, collect real settlement history, and compare any future provider against the built-in heuristic adapter before promoting it beyond the config-controlled port.
still_missing: No known gaps in the local-first enterprise hardening scope described by docs/plans/2026-05-29-enterprise-hardening.md.
Future productization may add packaged distribution, hosted multi-user services, or richer ML once settlement history exists.
